title: feat(ui): Interface Foundation — Phase A (v3.2)
body:
Implements Phase A of the Airtable Interface parity roadmap, introducing a self-contained, shareable, multi-page application surface distinct from the existing `AppSchema` navigation container. The Interface concept enables role-specific surfaces that stitch together views, elements, and actions into cohesive experiences.

### New: `InterfaceSchema` (`src/ui/interface.zod.ts`)
- `InterfaceSchema` — top-level entity with pages, branding, role assignments, default landing page
- `InterfaceBrandingSchema` — extends `AppBrandingSchema` with `coverImage`
- `defineInterface()` factory — exported from root `index.ts` alongside `defineView`, `defineApp`, `defineFlow`, `defineAgent`

### Unified Page System (`page.zod.ts`)
- `PageTypeSchema` — unified 16-type enum: 4 platform (`record`, `home`, `app`, `utility`) + 12 interface (`dashboard`, `grid`, `list`, `gallery`, `kanban`, `calendar`, `timeline`, `form`, `record_detail`, `record_review`, `overview`, `blank`)
- `RecordReviewConfigSchema` — sequential record review/approval with actions (`approve`/`reject`/`skip`/`custom`), navigation modes, field updates, progress indicator
- `icon` property added to `PageSchema` for interface navigation
- `InterfaceSchema.pages` references `PageSchema` directly (no separate `InterfacePageSchema`)

### Content Elements (`page.zod.ts`, `component.zod.ts`)
- Added `element:text`, `element:number`, `element:image`, `element:divider` to `PageComponentType`
- `ElementTextPropsSchema` — markdown content, variant, alignment
- `ElementNumberPropsSchema` — object/field aggregation (count/sum/avg/min/max), format, prefix/suffix
- `ElementImagePropsSchema` — src, alt, object-fit, height
- All registered in `ComponentPropsMap`

### Per-element Data Binding (`page.zod.ts`)
- `ElementDataSourceSchema` — object, view, filter, sort, limit
- `dataSource` optional property on `PageComponentSchema` — overrides page-level object context for multi-object dashboards

### Shared Primitives (`shared/enums.zod.ts`)
- Extracted `SortItemSchema` (`{ field, order }`) reusing `SortDirectionEnum` — replaces inline sort definitions across UI schemas

### Documentation & Roadmap
- ROADMAP.md Phase 8.1 Phase A marked as ✅ complete
- Codebase metrics updated (177 schema files, 199 test files, 5468 tests)
- Phase 1 deliverables updated with Interface, Content Elements, `defineInterface()`
- Design doc (`airtable-interface-gap-analysis.md`) status updated to "Phase A Implemented"
- Design doc Phase A checklist marked complete with additional merge/extract items
- Decision log expanded with entries #6-8 (PageSchema merge, SortItemSchema extraction, branding extend)

```typescript
const portal = defineInterface({
  name: 'order_management',
  label: 'Order Management',
  object: 'order',
  pages: [
    {
      name: 'page_dashboard', label: 'Dashboard', type: 'dashboard',
      regions: [{
        name: 'main',
        components: [
          { type: 'element:number', properties: { object: 'order', aggregate: 'sum', field: 'total', format: 'currency' },
            dataSource: { object: 'order', filter: { status: 'completed' } } },
        ],
      }],
    },
    {
      name: 'page_review', label: 'Review', type: 'record_review',
      recordReview: {
        object: 'order',
        actions: [
          { label: 'Approve', type: 'approve', field: 'status', value: 'approved' },
          { label: 'Reject', type: 'reject', field: 'status', value: 'rejected' },
        ],
      },
      regions: [],
    },
  ],
});
```

61 new tests. All 199 test files (5468 tests) pass.
